unresolved_people.name: Florence Budlong
unresolved_people.issue: The book's appendix (PDF pp. 297 and 300) spells her Florence Merrill Budlong and describes the companionship with Olive. Newton records from 1941 and 1947 corroborate a shared address but not a legal marriage or exact dates. Retain as documented historical partner association, not a spouse edge.

independent_sources.title: Newton City Directory (1941), Florence N. Budlong
independent_sources.finding: A published Newton directory lists Florence N. Budlong as a teacher living at 21 Elm Street. This alone does not prove the nature of her relationship with Olive.

independent_sources.title: Newton 1947 assessed polls, Elm Street no. 21
independent_sources.finding: A published 1947 municipal list names Olive A. Beveridge (teacher, birth year 1890) and Florence N. Budlong (teacher, birth year 1900) at 21 Elm Street. This independently corroborates association/co-residence, not legal marriage or exact vital dates.
